_about: Real, independently reported trip spend, hand-read from the cached source texts (ml/data/raw/tripoto, the app's own user journal). Used ONLY to validate the cost model, never to train it. in_scope_total = the author's total minus itemised inter-city travel / flights that the model deliberately does not price. per_person_per_day = in_scope_total / party / days. Nothing here is estimated or generated. old_catalog_base_daily_inr is a read-only snapshot of the previous catalog price (destinations.base_daily_cost before refresh), kept only as a comparison baseline.
